text: 今日晚间，多家A股上市公司发布股价异动公告，并进行相应的风险提示。 3连板中百集团公告称，公司股票连续两个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%，属于股票交易异常波动。敬请广大投资者注意二级市场交易风险，理性决策，审慎投资。 2连板红棉股份公告称，制糖业务收入占比68.07%，原糖价格上涨等对公司短期业绩影响不确定。 2连板精艺股份公告称，铜价上涨对公司经营不存在利好。 2连板黑猫股份公告称，炭黑产品价格上调仅为成本传导举措，并不必然导致公司利润同步增长。 2连板精华制药公告称，公司股票于9月8日、9月9日连续两个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%，
text_en: Multiple A-share companies issued announcements this evening regarding unusual stock price movements with risk warnings. Zhongbai Group, up three consecutive limit-ups, stated its cumulative closing price gain deviation exceeded 20% over two trading days, constituting abnormal trading. Red Cotton Holdings, up two consecutive limit-ups, said sugar business accounts for 68.07% of revenue, with raw sugar price increases having uncertain short-term impact. Jingyi Shares, up two consecutive limit-ups, noted copper price rises offer no benefit to operations. Black Cat Carbon, up two consecutive limit-ups, said carbon black price hikes are merely cost-pass-through measures and won't necessarily boost profits. Essence Pharmaceuticals, up two consecutive limit-ups, reported cumulative closing price gain deviation exceeding 20% on September 8 and 9.
